name: Bean Blessed Coffee
address: 13 Marsh St, Mossel Bay, 6500, South Africa
description_short: Artisan coffee roastery and café serving exceptional brews and light meals in Mossel Bay's heart.
description_long:
Tucked away on Marsh Street, Bean Blessed Coffee has earned a devoted following among Mossel Bay locals and visitors who appreciate properly roasted beans and expertly crafted cups. This independent roastery takes its coffee seriously, from sourcing to brewing, creating a warm space where the aroma alone is worth the visit.

The menu extends beyond excellent espresso to include wholesome breakfast options, fresh sandwiches, and home-baked treats that pair perfectly with their signature blends. The relaxed atmosphere makes it ideal for a morning coffee run, a leisurely catch-up with friends, or a quiet corner to work. With its central Mossel Bay location, it's become a genuine community hub where quality and friendliness come standard.

Whether you're a coffee enthusiast seeking a proper flat white or simply need a welcoming spot to refuel while exploring the Garden Route, Bean Blessed delivers consistently excellent service in unpretentious surrounds.
